title: Aromatic Flaky Algerian Semolina Grill
description: A sour and flaky solo dinner dish from Algeria featuring semolina rimacinata, this recipe is perfect for a weeknight meal, it is paleo friendly and made in a raclette grill.
instructions: Preheat the raclette grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the semolina rimacinata, salt, and black pepper.
Add the olive oil, lemon juice, and warm water to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and brush with olive oil.
Place the disks on the preheated raclette grill and cook for 2 minutes on each side.
While the semolina is cooking, mix the minced garlic and chopped parsley in a small bowl.
After the semolina is cooked, brush the garlic parsley mixture on top of each disk.
Serve the aromatic flaky Algerian semolina grill hot and enjoy.
